title: Ninja temperature kettle £59.99, Ninja Dual Zone £159 and a £24 heated throw
description: Monday's checked UK deals: Ninja's temperature kettle and Dual Zone air fryer at their lows, a £24 heated throw and two beauty gift sets.
intro:
**Today's best buy is the Ninja Perfect Temperature Kettle at £59.99 on Amazon, the lowest price PriceSpy has tracked.** Argos, Very and AO all charge about £10 more. Ninja air fryers are the other story today: the 9.5-litre Foodi Max Dual Zone is £159 at AO and the 6.2-litre AF170 is £100 at Argos, both at their lowest recent prices.

Very's Black Friday sale starts today and runs to 4 December, so there are now Black Friday sales at almost every big UK retailer except Amazon. This week's spotlight is Christmas beauty gift sets, so we've added two that are already reduced. Buy now or wait? The kettle, both air fryers and the mesh Wi-Fi are at their lows, so buy now. The Ninja Crispi has been £10 cheaper, so wait for that one.

deals.name: Ninja Perfect Temperature Kettle KT200UKCP, 1.7L, Black and Copper
deals.note: The lowest Amazon price on PriceSpy's chart, and about £9–£10 less than Argos, Very and AO. Ignore the £99.99 'was' you'll see elsewhere; it's the list price, not a recent selling price. Lets you pick the temperature for green tea or coffee, so it makes a good kitchen gift too.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi MAX Dual Zone Air Fryer AF400UK, 9.5L
deals.note: At the bottom of its £159–£199.99 range on PriceSpy. Two big drawers that cook separately and finish together, so it suits a family. Our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) has target prices for every Ninja model.

deals.name: Ninja Air Fryer AF170UK, 6.2L
deals.note: Which? puts £100 at its lowest price for six months, against an average of about £123. A single large drawer is enough for two to four people, and it's a simpler, cheaper choice than a dual-drawer model.

deals.name: TP-Link Deco X55 Wi-Fi 6 Mesh System, 3-Pack
deals.note: Below anything PriceSpy has recorded for this pack, and flagged as 25% under its usual price. Three units cover a bigger house or a garden office where the router's Wi-Fi doesn't reach.

deals.name: Dunelm Fleece Electric Throw
deals.note: One of the cheapest heated throws from a big-name shop, in charcoal or taupe. Dunelm doesn't list the heat settings or timer, so check the product page if auto-off matters to you. A useful under-£25 gift for someone who feels the cold.

deals.name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum Gift Set 50ml (with 10ml spray and 100ml body mist)
deals.note: 20% off a new Christmas set, which is about what fragrance sets usually drop to on Black Friday. A safe present for someone who likes a sweet, evening-style scent. See this week's [beauty gift sets spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/).

deals.name: Fenty Skin Body Lil' Mists Duo
deals.note: 30% off, and the only reduced beauty gift set we found on John Lewis's gift set page today. A small, easy present for a Secret Santa or a stocking.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi 4-in-1 Portable Glass Air Fryer FN101UKSG, 3.8L, Sage
deals.note: The glass dish goes from fryer to table to fridge, which suits one or two people. AO charges the same, but it's been £109.99 in the last three months, so it's worth waiting to see if Black Friday brings that back.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Not for the Ninja kettle, the two Ninja air fryers or the Deco mesh: all four are at or below their recent lows, and Black Friday prices rarely beat that by much. The Crispi is the one to hold off on. Our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) lists the prices worth waiting for, model by model.

Very's sale goes live today and runs until 4 December; our [Very Black Friday guide](/guides/very-black-friday-2026/) explains what to expect. We've also updated our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) with Very, John Lewis and Superdrug's dates, and our [Boots Black Friday guide](/guides/boots-black-friday-2026/) now that Boots's sale is live.

## This week: Christmas beauty gift sets

This week's spotlight is [Christmas beauty gift sets 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/). It covers which sets are already reduced and which are still at full price. For presents across every category, our new [Christmas gifts for her under £50 guide](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/) has nine checked ideas, from a £18 Le Creuset mug to an afternoon tea for two.
